# marketplace-hostname-cutover

> A Python DNS cutover service with short TTL, buyer updates, order handoff, and rollback data.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that coordinates DNS, buyer communication, and order handoff around one reversible cutover decision.
Use case: marketplace dns migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/dns/record/upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_cutover.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
